name: Ngo nuong
summary: Ngô nướng is night nếp corn, sweet and spicy. One account brushes the ear with tương ớt and butter before the grill.
origin: Vinh. Both pages put it on the night sidewalk. Báo Nghệ An, 28 April 2023, names ngô on the mobile kiosks at Đào Tấn.
howToEat: Eat it at night, on the walk. Use the 2016 sauce only as that article’s account: tương ớt and butter. The 24 November 2022 page says nếp corn, sweet and spicy, and does not name the smear. A price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress, 4 September 2016, names the citadel gate, the gate of công viên Nguyễn Tất Thành, and the gate of rạp 12-9. Báo Nghệ An puts ngô on the Đào Tấn mobile kiosks, 18:00–06:00 on the 27 April 2023 account. A 2026 night list was not opened.
